ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a transition-state structure, with a benzene ring at the lower left; the benzene ring is connected through an oxygen atom to the central carbon; the upper left of the central carbon is connected to an EtO group, and the upper right is connected to an oxygen atom, which is further connected to AlCl3; the lower right of the central carbon is connected to a segment of side chain, and the end of the side chain is a carbonyl C=O and is connected to an R group. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning count: Count part by part according to bonds between heavy atoms, not counting any hydrogen-related bonds. Inside the benzene ring there are 6 ring bonds; benzene ring to oxygen and that oxygen to central carbon are 2 bonds in total; central carbon to EtO oxygen and the O-C and C-C two bonds inside EtO are 3 bonds in total; central carbon to upper oxygen and upper oxygen to Al are 2 bonds in total; Al-Cl has 3 bonds; central carbon to side-chain carbon, side-chain carbon to carbonyl carbon, carbonyl C=O, and carbonyl carbon to R are 4 bonds in total. The total number is 6 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 20.

method.method_draft: Partition the image into components and tally heavy-atom bonds: phenyl ring = 6 ring bonds; phenyl-O and O-central carbon = 2 more; central carbon to EtO oxygen plus the two internal ethoxy bonds = 3; central carbon to upper O and upper O to Al = 2; three Al-Cl bonds = 3; central carbon to side-chain carbon, side-chain carbon to carbonyl carbon, carbonyl C=O, and carbonyl carbon to R = 4. Sum these component counts to obtain 20.

推理计数：按重原子之间的键逐部分统计，不计任何氢相关键。苯环内部有 6 个环键；苯环到氧、该氧到中心碳共 2 个键；中心碳到 EtO 氧以及 EtO 内部的 O-C 和 C-C 两个键，共 3 个键；中心碳到上方氧、上方氧到 Al 共 2 个键；Al-Cl 有 3 个键；中心碳到侧链碳、侧链碳到羰基碳、羰基 C=O、羰基碳到 R 共 4 个键。总数为 6 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 20。
